record.edic_text:
4292 prokaleomai {prok-al-eh'-om-ahee}

middle voice from 4253 and 2564; TDNT - 3:496,*; v

AV - provoke 1; 1

1) to call forth
2) to call forth to one's self
   2a) esp. to challenge to a combat or contest with one
3) to provoke, to irritate
